The right strategy is wide-range value betting (top pair with a weak kicker can be worth two to three streets) at 2/3 pot+. opp-drill-q3.explanation: VPIP 48% / PFR 38% / AF 6.5 / 3-Bet 16% is a classic Maniac: extremely loose-aggressive with high bluff frequency. The right strategy is to tighten your range and 4-Bet for value with strong hands (QQ+/AK) or call and trap, letting him donate chips. Never bluff (he won't fold). Changing tables is escaping — you'd miss the chance to profit from the most exploitable opponent.

Folding non-premium hands is wrong (JJ/TT/AK all have significant value).

Folding medium-strength hands is wrong — the LAG's range is wide, so top pair / medium pairs still have value.

opp-drill-q7.explanation: VPIP 19% / PFR 16% / AF 3.2 / 3-Bet 6% is a classic TAG (tight-aggressive): reasonable range, standard C-Bets, adjusts by position. TAGs are hard to exploit — use GTO strategy with only mild exploitation of his Fold to C-Bet 55% (slightly above the GTO 50%, so you can add a few C-Bet bluffs). Relentless bluffing is wrong (55% Fold to C-Bet isn't high enough), and value-only is also wrong (his fold rate supports reasonable bluffs).
